page.overview:
What is Anghabar?

Anghabar was a mine in the northern part of the Echoriad range of mountains that encircled the hidden elven realm of Gondolin during the First Age.

It is unknown whether Anghabar was delved in the northern part of the Echoriad

Anghabar is a Sindarin name meaning "iron mine" or "Iron-delvings" from the word ang ("iron") and a soft-mutation of sabar ("delving").

In 1981, Karen Wynn Fonstad speculated that the Mines of Anghabar lay under the Echoriad On December 12 of 2019, Mark Fisher speculated on The Encyclopedia of Arda that Anghabar was located "on the inner slopes of the" Encircling Mountains. It is also highly likely that weapons such as Glamdring, Orcrist, and Sting were made with ores from Anghabar.
